# Tool & resource catalog

> Generated by `npm run docs:tools` from the running server. Do not edit by hand.

**127 tools**, 6 prompts, 6 resources, 2 resource templates.

## Prompts

- `getting_started` — Orientation for driving the Mineflayer bot: how to connect, observe, act, and recover.
- `gather_wood` (count?, logType?) — Find nearby trees and collect logs.
- `mine_to_diamonds` (targetY?) — Descend safely and branch-mine at diamond depth.
- `build_shelter` (material?) — Enclose a small safe space before nightfall.
- `find_and_smelt` (input, fuel?) — Mine an ore (or gather an input) and smelt it in a furnace.
- `follow_and_defend` (player) — Follow a player and fight off hostile mobs near them.

## Resources

- `bot://state` — Live self snapshot: position, vitals, gamemode, time, weather, held item, control states.
- `bot://inventory` — Live inventory: items, armor, off-hand, held slot, empty slots.
- `world://entities` — Up to 50 nearest tracked entities (players, mobs, items).
- `world://players` — All players on the server with ping, gamemode and position.
- `bot://events` — Tail of the most recent buffered game events.
- `bot://waypoints` — Saved named waypoints (persisted across restarts).
- `block://{x}/{y}/{z}` (template) — Block at world coordinate x/y/z (e.g. block://10/64/-20).
- `entity://{id}` (template) — Tracked entity by network id (e.g. entity://123).
